Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc.bin')
# Try to hit frame header sync/UTF-8 parsing with a bogus continuation sequence near EOF.
payload = bytearray(b'fLaC')
payload += bytes([0x00,0x00,0x00,0x22]) + b'\x00'*34
# repeated sync-like bytes and malformed utf8 header bits
payload += b'\xff\xf8\x69\x00' + b'\xff\x80\x80\x80\x80'
# very little data afterward
payload += b'\x00'
p.write_bytes(payload)
print('len', len(payload))
PY
